text:
Ivy: Need a crisp DP plan for a Quantization Benchmarking beta. Roadmap slot tomorrow. Key asks: partner profile, minimum deliverables, success signals, legal/incentive framing, rollback safety. Target 6-8 partners, 3-week pilot. Quick takes? :mag:
Dan: Ops first: for quantization we must limit to hosted + VPC. No on-prem/air-gapped this round. Require model variant pinning and a read-only perf dashboard. Also need a per-org quant-profile lock so we don't get noisy perf shifts.
Priya: Feedback loop: partners provide a canonical 40-example prompt set + 15 labeled edge cases. We'll run nightly quant-bench (int8 vs fp16 parity) and surface per-example diffs. Want to include a small labeling UI and a CSV export.
Zoe: Recruitment/incentives: prefer infra-heavy teams willing to test cost-focused optimizations (latency and token-CPU tradeoffs). Incentive idea: $800 credits + a tailored quant report and 2 office-hour sessions. Screen for legal readiness and ability to share anonymized payloads. Avoid regulated sectors for this cohort.
Marco: Minimal scope we can promise: model version pinning, a quantization-safe serving path, telemetry (latency, tokens, quality metrics), and weekly diff decks. Not promising custom kernels, hardware tuning, or new quant formats.
Ivy: Agree. Also promise a clear rollback: per-route feature-flag that reverts to fp16 variant instantly if quality or latency regressions exceed thresholds.
Dan: Implementation note: add intake fields for expected_eval_examples_count and expected_peak_qps so infra can size caching and KV. We'll also enforce token caps and an 80% webhook warn.
Priya: Success metrics proposal:
- Activation: >=70% partners upload canonical set and run at least one automated bench within 5 days
- Quality: median per-example quality regression <5% when moving to quantized variant
- Efficiency: median cost or compute reduction >=20% across partners
- Commercial signal: >=25% partners request roadmap commitment or follow-up trial
Zoe: UX acceptance: partners can export bench CSV and labeled annotations within 48h of onboarding. They should be able to flip quant profile in console and run a local eval script we provide.
Marco: Safety thresholds: auto-revert if mean quality drop >7% absolute or p95 latency increase >25%. Also post-revert we create an incident ticket and ping partner + #oncall.
Ivy: Intake form snippet (for outreach) that Dan/Marco can use:
```
- org_name
- contact_name / email
- product_owner
- workload_type (chat/batch/rerank)
- expected_peak_qps
- avg_prompt_tokens
- can_share_prompts (yes/no)
- expected_eval_examples_count
- legal_ready (yes/no)
- preferred_deploy (hosted/vpc)
- desired_start_date
```
Dan: infra-bot: please publish a minimal intake form with those fields and include retention_days_for_logs and sampling_rate.
infra-bot: forms-publish: quant-bench-beta-intake v1 posted to /internal/beta-forms (status: success)
Zoe: Outreach list: I'll compile 12 targets and surface top 8 fits. Also will draft outreach copy with clear ask + incentive details (ETA: today EOD).
Priya: Action items quick:
- Dan: add intake fields + implement auto-revert thresholds (ETA: EOD)
- Priya: draft benchmark diff deck template and eval scripts (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Zoe: outreach list & copy + incentive wording (ETA: today EOD)
- Marco: publish onboarding checklist and sample harness repo (ETA: tomorrow)
Ivy: Any objections to hosted/VPC-only or incentive level? If none I'll lock and add to roadmap slide. :white_check_mark:
